column1: # tools/timing/sdc_exceptions.tsv: the registry of every timing exception the build reads.
# One row per exception, TAB-separated. tools/check_sdc_exceptions.py holds the SDC sources and this
# file together (every exception line has exactly one row, every row's match occurs exactly once),
# and, with --fit, the per-fit counts tools/timing/sdc_audit.tcl writes against min..max.
# Columns: id, source (template = tools/profile/z486_mister.sdc.in, profile_gen = rendered by
# tools/profile_gen.py, sys_top = sys/sys_top.sdc, hdl = an HDL-embedded SDC), when (always or the
# build option it depends on), kind (what the pattern counts: registers/keepers/pins/ports/clocks),
# pattern (for sdcvar_nodup: the SDC collection variable), min, max (the count a fitted netlist must show), measure (from/to: the census times the
# paths with this exception removed; fall: its falling-edge launches are listed; - : not measured), match (the start of the SDC command line),
# proof (why the exception is safe, with its citation).

column10: the video PLL against the framework clocks: every crossing is a Gray FIFO pointer or a 2FF level (docs/clock-domains.md V1-V5)

clk_sys -> clk_vid: the core's Gray FIFO pointer and 2FF levels (docs/clock-domains.md V2-V3) PLUS raw quasi-static framework words (gamma_en, OSD/LFB/HDMI_PR config into vga_osd, videow, vmini..): SOFTWARE-PACED, NOT CYCLE-EXACT. Every endpoint must be on check_sdc_exceptions.py's whitelist (XEND)

clk_vid -> clk_sys: the vsync synchronisers (V5) PLUS raw multi-bit framework words read by the HPS (hps_io video_calc counters, arx/ary, sync_fix): SOFTWARE-PACED, NOT CYCLE-EXACT (the HPS re-polls). Endpoints whitelisted (XEND)
hold of the same crossings; the endpoint whitelist (XEND) keeps a new clk_sys -> clk_vid word from losing its hold check silently
output DDIO with datain_h == datain_l: the falling-edge mux switch selects an equal value (tools/profile_gen.py render_out_cut)
the input DDIO low halves have no consumer (tools/profile_gen.py render_dq_lo_cut)
setup-2 shifted single-cycle capture, default hold deliberately (template comment; sdram.v T_RCD+CAS+2)

SOFTWARE-PACED, NOT CYCLE-EXACT: the OSD word changes only at HPS command pace (microseconds); a consumer could see a multi-bit field torn for a cycle. Consumers are levels or sampled in reset (reset_req, ram_size_sel, the *_eff latches, the audio level handshake); see docs/clock-domains.md "Quasi-static levels"

SOFTWARE-PACED, NOT CYCLE-EXACT: Main_MiSTer user_io_init sends UIO_SET_MEMSZ (0x31, user_io.h) once and then resets the core (user_io_status_set("[0]", 1)); that is the only sender in user_io.cpp (other Main_MiSTer files not searched). Every consumer is reset after the change

2FF first stage of the clk_44100 toggle (src/soc/cdda.v); clk_d1 also feeds the agree-compare that gates the tick, so a metastable clk_d1 is filtered by clk_d2 == clk_d1. Redundant with the sys_top.sdc groups
2FF stages of HDMI_TX_VS (sys/sys_top.v:544-548, 1088-1093); redundant with the sys_top.sdc groups
HDL-embedded SDC of altera_std_synchronizer (pll_cfg_hdmi): the first stage of a depth-3 synchroniser of a 1-bit PLL locked

pixel_ce: SYNC roots loaded only on pixel_ce && frame_end -> text-fetch registers loaded only on pixel_ce; pulses >= floor(DEN/NUM31) apart (template comment, pc9821_crtc.sv:561/1833/1613); counts the sources, retimed _OTERM/_NEW_REG registers removed. 73 when synthesis keeps all SYNC roots (sdc-68d9f886), 59 when it retimes s_lc80_r and part of s_va_r/s_lc40_r into _OTERM chains (sdc-32503923); the count is fixed per build, the same on all seeds
hold N-1 of the same multicycle; counts the destinations

io_strobe: cmd/byte_cnt change only on a strobe or the ~io_enable clear (sys/hps_io.sv:330/339/342/561); status (:500-507) and img_size (:495) load only on a later strobe.
